title: Original Oven Roasted American Tofu Bowl
description: A grassy and crunchy meal prep American dish featuring soya milk and bhuna, perfect for a dairy-free friendly meal.

ingredients.name: roasted vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as broccoli, carrots, and bell peppers

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together soya milk, bhuna spice blend, and olive oil.
Add the cubed tofu to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Spread the tofu on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the tofu is roasting, prepare the mixed greens and roasted vegetables.
In a small bowl, whisk together lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
To assemble the bowls, divide the mixed greens between four bowls, then top with roasted tofu, roasted vegetables, and crunchy almonds.
Drizzle the lemon juice dressing over the top of each bowl.
